statement: The record says the Midterm exam column is configured for 100 points, while all 180 marks are out of 10, so I will post the grades against 10 points to preserve the marked scores.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "the Midterm exam column is configured for 100 points, while all 180 marks are out of 10," identifying the specific mismatch and giving the correct value (10 points).
